aboutText: PRC Electrical, licensed under REC No: 13541, provides expert electrical services to Laverton North and the greater Melbourne area. Our experienced electricians handle everything from emergency breakdowns to planned installations, specialising in industrial and commercial sectors including packaging, food processing, and mining. We ensure compliance with test and tag standards and safety systems, delivering reliable solutions for businesses of all sizes.
servicesText: Our team offers a full range of electrical services tailored to Laverton North businesses. From industrial maintenance to commercial fit-outs, we prioritise safety, efficiency, and compliance with Australian standards.
